title: 第一卷 第17章 前往石桥村第一卷 第18章 披皮狼妖
lines: 第二天一早，天刚亮，秦烈就醒了。
他先是看了一眼床边的镇妖刀，又看了一眼自己的面板。
【境界：九品初期。】
【功法：基础炼体法·（入门）】
【术法：望气术】
【自由属性点：2.85】
昨天晚上那一通没白折腾，好歹他现在已经不是那个没入品的新人了。
虽然是九品初期，但也算是踏进武道的门槛了。
今天要去石桥村查疑似狼妖的案子，也是他进镇妖司之后的第一次任务，说不紧张那肯定是假的。
毕竟这次可不是百妖鉴里的幻境，也不是昨天测试的时候有人在旁边看着。
这次的妖物如果是真的，那可是会杀人的。
不过妖物会杀人，他也会杀妖物，谁是猎人谁是猎物还不一定呢。
如果能出现一些像母蜘蛛那样的妖物就更好了，还可以再刷一波属性点。
秦烈感觉现在自己刷属性点已经刷上瘾了。
起来洗了把脸，又把镇妖司的黑色劲装换上，然后把镇妖刀挂在腰间。
人靠衣装马靠鞍，这句话还不是白说的，穿上之后整个人比昨天显得精神多了。
秦烈推门出去，就看见许青禾已经在院子里站着了。
她今天穿的也是镇妖司的黑色衣裳，头发简单竖着，手里还抱着一个小册子。
秦烈走过去跟她打了个招呼。
“早啊，许书吏。”
许青禾抬头看了他一眼。
“早，不用叫我书吏，你跟他们一样喊我青禾就行。”
“许书吏，陆大人和李大哥呢？”
秦烈本来想按照许青禾的意思喊的，但是喊了一半发现自己喊不出口。
才认识两三天，就这样亲昵的称呼，好像也有点不太合适。
许青禾倒也没计较秦烈对她的称呼。
“他们俩今天有其他的任务忙去了。”
“石桥村这个任务只是一个探查任务，还没确定到底是不是妖物。”
“所以今天只有你跟我去。”
“明白。”
秦烈听了之后点了点头。
昨天陆沉已经交代过了，今天以许青禾为主，那么许青禾说啥就是啥。
“第一次出任务紧张吗？”
许青禾看了秦烈一眼，语气平静。
content_en:
The next morning, Qin Lie woke up at dawn.
He first glanced at the demon-suppressing knife beside the bed, and then at his own panel.
[Realm: Early stage of ninth grade. 】
[Exercise: Basic Body Training·(Introductory)]
[Spell: Qi Watching Technique]
[Free attribute points: 2.85]
The trouble last night was not in vain, at least he is no longer the unqualified newcomer.
Although he is in the early stage of ninth grade, he is still on the threshold of martial arts.
Today he was going to Shiqiao Village to investigate a suspected wolf demon case. It was also his first mission after joining the Demon Suppression Department. If he said he wasn't nervous, he would definitely be lying.
After all, this time is not an illusion in Bai Yao Jian, nor is it someone watching from the side during the test yesterday.
If the monster this time is real, it will kill people.
However, monsters can kill people, and he can also kill monsters. It is not certain who is the hunter and who is the prey.
It would be better if some monsters like the female spider could appear, and you could also brush up another wave of attribute points.
Qin Lie feels that he is now addicted to collecting attribute points.
He got up and washed his face, put on the black costume of the Demon Suppressing Division, and hung the Demon Suppressing Sword on his waist.
It’s not for nothing that a man relies on his clothes and a horse relies on his saddle. After putting it on, he looked much more energetic than yesterday.
Qin Lie pushed the door open and saw Xu Qinghe already standing in the yard.
She was also wearing the black clothes of the Demon Suppression Department today, her hair was simply standing up, and she was holding a pamphlet in her hand.
Qin Lie walked over and said hello to her.
"Good morning, Secretary Xu."
Xu Qinghe raised his head and glanced at him.
"Good morning, no need to call me scribe, just call me Qinghe like them."
"Okay, Qing..."
"Secretary Xu, where are Master Lu and Brother Li?"
Qin Lie originally wanted to shout according to Xu Qinghe's intention, but halfway through shouting, he found that he couldn't shout.
We have only known each other for two or three days, so it seems a bit inappropriate to call her such an intimate name.
Xu Qinghe didn't care what Qin Lie called her.
"They are both busy with other tasks today."
"This mission in Shiqiao Village is just an exploration mission. We haven't determined whether it is a monster or not."
"So you're the only one coming with me today."
"Understood."
Qin Lie nodded after hearing this.
Lu Chen had already explained yesterday that Xu Qinghe would take the lead today, so Xu Qinghe would do whatever he said.
"Are you nervous about your first mission?"
Xu Qinghe glanced at Qin Lie and spoke calmly.
